title: AxiomDiagnosticResponse
description: A 200 response from POST /api/diagnose. Errors use error.schema.json.

title.description: Two to six words naming the finding.

detail.description: Two to three sentences of substance.

title.description: A working style, never a kind of person.

detail.description: Where the two approaches pull against each other.

bridge.description: Something practical the reader can do about it.

composite_archetype.description: Two to four words describing how this configuration decides. Descriptive, never a verdict.

executive_summary.description: Two to three sentences on deciding under pressure. Mechanism, never motive.

rigidity_index.description: Judged on the specificity of the breaking points, not on the height of the conviction values.

strengths.description: Each is evidenced from the participant's own words and names what the strength costs.

growth_areas.description: Each names a tension between stance and breaking point, and one concrete thing to try.

stress_response_prediction.description: Likely first reaction when something fails without warning. Observable behaviour only.
